fail_closed_rules: Sold Prior or Sold Post without a disclosed consideration does not receive an inferred price.
Withdrawn Prior or Withdrawn Post is not represented as a completed sale.
Seller top-ups, rent-free periods, stepped rents and gross/net income are kept distinct from passing rent.
Future indexed or fixed rent changes, tenant options and holding-over events are not silently resolved.
Proposed development, alternative use, conversion and planning potential remain subject to consents.
Receiver, title, overage, inaccessible-area, physical-condition and legal-pack caveats are preserved.
Historical tenancy facts are kept separate from current registry status.
